issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 2.00 (Special Revenue - Keno column)
issues.issue: Detail line takes keno/lottery from the fund name, but the matching statement receipt receipts[10] (Local Receipts: Other 148,553) still holds these 2 dollars as category other. The same printed line is categorized two ways in one report, and the fund-name rule covers only a fund's tax receipts. The amount is immaterial, but the two categories should match.

issues.on_page: Line 45 Solid Waste 23,512.00, printed under 'Business-Type Activities' heading but in the General Fund column
issues.issue: Fund type is a judgment call. The column says governmental (General Fund) but the row heading says business-type. Recorded as governmental with category utilities. Also applies to detail[12].

issues.on_page: Line 3 Subtotal of Beginning Balance (governmental columns) 284,359; line 1 Net Cash Balance 278,794 + line 2 Investments 5,565
issues.issue: beginning_cash and ending_cash (264,990, line 24) include the General Fund CDs (5,565 / 5,623), and beginning_investments/ending_investments repeat those amounts. This is consistent with the statement's roll-forward and is noted as informational, but any consumer adding cash + investments would double count 5,565 / 5,623.
